areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Urban flood-control objective tied to the sanitation/drainage aspect; indicators not SMART but show goal delivery; benefited population small relative to the city, so low strategic impact despite very large resource share.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Relevant to natural-area conservation via a solid-waste diversion indicator with viable target, but limited impact against the area's breadth and no clear evidence of solution effectiveness.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: General objective directly aligned; flood-area and beneficiary indicators with viable targets; very large resource share; directly protected group small but indirect beneficiaries and efficiency give moderate impact.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Drainage component linked to water quality, but the related indicator target is modest, impact isolated and effectiveness for broader water-security goals not demonstrated.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Only incidental leisure/sport equipment around the reservoirs; no objective, indicator or target on sport access, and a minimal budget share.

not_accepted.name: Sport
not_accepted.reason: Only incidental leisure/sport equipment around the reservoirs; no objective, indicator or target on sport access, and a minimal budget share.

bonus.reason: Proponent declared alignment with the climate-emergency priority; resources are entirely directed to climate adaptation measures against floods and droughts.
